## Iteration Strategy

1. Be independently testable
2. Produce a working (if incomplete) system
3. Have clear acceptance criteria
4. Build on the previous iteration

## Risk Checkpoints

After each iteration, evaluate:
- [ ] Did the iteration complete within expected effort?
- [ ] Are we still aligned with the design?
- [ ] Do we need to revise the plan for remaining iterations?
- [ ] Are there new risks that weren't in the design doc?

---

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] Every iteration is independently testable
- [ ] First iteration is the smallest useful thing (fail fast)
- [ ] Each iteration builds on the last (no throwaway work)
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are specific and automatable where possible
- [ ] Risk checkpoints are scheduled (not afterthoughts)
